title: Goin' Coastal | Pet Friendly | 6-Seater Golf Cart | Seacrest Vacation Rental | Book Direct & Save
h1: Goin' Coastal | Pet Friendly | 6-Seater Golf Cart
description_expanded: SummaryNestled in the Magnolia Cottages community, Goin’ Coastal is a stylish and pet-friendly getaway just minutes from the beach. Enjoy the convenience of a 6-seater street-legal golf cart, a large screened-in porch, and access to a heated community pool. This beautifully decorated home offers an open-concept living space, a fully equipped kitchen, and comfortable accommodations for up to 7 guests. Plus, we provide beach chairs, a beach wagon, and towels to make your beach days effortless!SpaceGoin' Coastal is exclusively located in the beautiful neighborhood of Magnolia Cottages, Creek Park. This professionally decorated single family home is tucked away in between The Big Chill and Rosemary Beach, surrounded by endless shops, restaurants & entertainment. This luxurious 3 Bedroom/3.5 Bath home comes complete with numerous upgrades and all the conveniences of home! ADDED BONUS… This home comes with a 6-seater street legal golf cart, 6 beach chairs, beach towels, beach wagon & is pet friendly! From the moment you walk through the front door, time and worries of the world will melt away as you are captured by the serenity of this gorgeous home. The smell of the salt air, the soft rustling of the palm trees and the distant sound of the waves crashing on the beach will instantly transport you. Goin' Coastal L has been professionally designed with the utmost attention to detail while featuring a light and airy floor plan with a soothing color palette, hardwood flooring and 10ft ceilings. You will enter the home through a beautiful screened in porch where you can enjoy a morning coffee, afternoon book or an evening cocktail. The sun filled Living Room has comfortable seating for the whole family with a 50” flat screen Smart TV, it’s the perfect place to kick off your shoes and relax. It is well suited for families or couples with a fully equipped kitchen, 5 burner stove, stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. The Dining Room features a custom built-in banquet that seats 10, plus additional seating at the bar for 4. Additionally, on the first floor you will find a half bath and laundry room with full sized washer and dryer, iron & ironing board. There are two master suites - the first floor Master Bedroom features a plush king bed, large walk-in closet with luggage racks, 43” flat screen Smart TV and luxurious ensuite bath with dual sinks and walk-in shower with floor to ceiling tile. The second Master Bedroom located upstairs, also has a king bed, 43” flat screen SMART TV, closet with luggage racks and an ensuite bath that is unexpectedly bold but timeless and the perfect place to escape with a luxurious shower & dual sinks. The 3rd bedroom also on the second floor is a playful bunk room with a twin over full bed, 43” flat screen Smart TV and private ensuite bath with a tub/shower combination. Careful attention has been given to ensure an excellent experience which includes your children and fur babies. There are games for kids and toys, treats, dog beds, crates, blankets and towels for the dogs. This home sits on a corner lot with a private, fenced backyard great for both kids and dogs and access to the gorgeous community pool!! The golf cart allows for convenient access to the private beach entrance (parking available at the front of the neighborhood). Note that a separate golf cart waiver will be sent after booking. Drivers' licenses and proof of insurance is required prior to receiving the golf cart lock box code. You must be 25 years or older with a valid drivers license to operate the cart. Pet fee - a pet fee of $250/stay will be applied, see more below TRANSPORTATION - Street Legal 6 person golf cart (with signed waiver - must be 25 to operate) - Bikes are popular on 30A! Should you decide to rent some, a discount code to a local bike shop will be provided with your arrival information. HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Golf Cart Parking: There's designated parking at the front of the neighborhood between Morgan Street and the Waterhouse condos. - Large resort style pool (heated depending on ambient nightly temperatures) - Community green space (located at pool) BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE: - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by a local vendor; information provided upon request SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 7) - PRIMARY SUITE; 1st Floor, King Bed, Private Bath with walk-in shower, dual vanities - KING SUITE; 2nd Floor, King Bed, Private Bath with walk-in shower, dual vanities - BUNK ROOM; 2nd Floor, Twin over double bunk, Private bath with tub/shower FEATURES: - 30A – 3 Bedroom / 3.5 Bathroom House - Sleeps 7 (King, King, Twin/Full bunks) - Pet Friendly – complete with dog treats, beds, toys, crates, towels, blankets & couch cover (no more than 2 dogs, must be under 40lbs, house broken, NO puppies, bathed/groomed and on flea & tick prevention) - $250/stay - 6-Seater Street Legal Golf Cart - must be 25 to operate with signed waiver - Huge Screened Porch - Large Sun-filled Open Floor Plan - Fully Appointed Kitchen with professional ice maker - Full Size Washer & Dryer - TV in Living Room & Bedrooms w/Unlimited Streaming w/Hulu & Netflix - FREE Wi-Fi - Use of Owners 6 Beach Chairs, Beach Towels & Blankets & Beach Wagon - Parking for 2 cars in driveway and 1 along street - Large Resort Style community Pool - Close Proximity To The Beach - neighborhood is immediately across 30A from the beach access - 18 Mile Bike Path Along 30A - Close to The Big chill, Seaside, Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. Rosemary Beach and Seaside have Farmers Markets throughout the year along with great restaurants and shops. The Hub is perfect for families to take in a concert, movie or sporting event in its large pavilion while also enjoying restaurants / food trucks and shops. SECURITY: - This home does have a surveillance device at entry pointsNeighborhoodMagnolia Cottages by the Sea is a small, discreet neighborhood tucked away between Seagrove and Alys Beaches. It is close to everything, but still offers the comforts of a beach vacation coupled with a quiet getaway.TransitThe golf cart allows easy transportation and parking to the nearby beaches.AccessGuests can access all of the home and share access to the pool and deeded beach access. Guests are also entitled to the the golf cart (waiver to be signed, and pictures of drivers licenses and automobile insurance required). Guests also receive a 10% discount for bikes at a local bike rental company.NotesWe love dogs and are happy to provide a dog friendly space for your vacation! However, it's important to note that dogs are not allowed on any of the beaches along 30A. There is a dog beach at Pier Park located at 16303 Front Beach Rd. Panama City Beach where Fido can meet some new friends and enjoy our gorgeous Emerald Coast! We would like everyone to have a wonderful experience while visiting. Please note that county quiet hours begin at 10pm. A Note on Shared Amenities: Please keep in mind that these spaces are operated by the HOA. Because of this, they are subject to seasonal availability—common seasonal closures may include April-May and Sept-Nov—and we can't be held responsible for unexpected closures or repairs. If you are booking specifically for a shared amenity, please feel free to reach out with any questions in advance!House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets (dogs only) are only allowed with Owners/Property Managers' prior approval. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and the Guest will be evicted. Pet fees may apply. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted.Read Less
